We are always looking for motivated, creative, and driven students to join the iHuman Lab at Oklahoma State University. Our research sits at the intersection of human-centered computing, AI, and robotics. We value curiosity, collaboration, and initiative.

## Research Opportunities

We typically recruit: **PhD students**, **MS students**, and **Undergraduate researchers** students in:

* Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
* Electrical & Computer Science Engineering
* Human-Computer Interaction
* AI / Machine Learning
* Related disciplines

## What We Look For

Successful lab members typically demonstrate:

* Strong programming skills
* Research curiosity and initiative
* Interest in human-centered AI
* Solid communication and teamwork skills

Prior research experience is helpful but not required.

## How to Apply

If you are interested in joining the lab:

1. Prepare your CV
2. Include an unofficial transcript
3. Write a short research statement describing:
   * Your research interests
   * Why you want to join the iHuman Lab
   * Your long-term goals

## Contact

Please email the following materials with the subject line:

> **Prospective Student – [Your Name]** to [ihuman.research.lab@gmail.com](ihuman.research.lab@gmail.com)

Alternatively, you may contact us directly through the School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering at Oklahoma State University.

## Location

The iHuman Lab is located at Oklahoma State University.
